titulo: The Baby Monitor Picked Up a Second Voice #Shorts
titulo_pt: A babá eletrônica captou uma segunda voz
resumo_pt: Uma babá ouve pela babá eletrônica o menino prometendo a alguém que vai deixá-lo entrar quando ela dormir. Ela finge dormir no sofá, e a segunda voz agradece ao menino, mas vem de dentro da sala, ao lado dela.
descricao:
He promised to let someone in once I fell asleep. So I pretended.

Would you have opened your eyes?

Follow @VeilFrequency for a new horror story every day. Fictional story. Images are AI-generated.

scenes.text: The Hendersons said their son sleeps through the night. They never said he talks.
scenes.visual: baby monitor glowing green on a dark suburban kitchen counter at night
scenes.pt: Os Henderson disseram que o filho dorme a noite toda. Nunca disseram que ele fala.

scenes.text: Around midnight, the baby monitor crackled.
scenes.visual: close-up of a baby monitor speaker with small green lights in a dark room
scenes.pt: Perto da meia-noite, a babá eletrônica chiou.

scenes.visual: dark child's bedroom with a dim night light and a small bed, toys on the floor
scenes.pt: O Lucas estava sussurrando com alguém.

scenes.text: Okay. I'll let you in when she's asleep.
scenes.pt: Tá bom. Eu deixo você entrar quando ela dormir.

scenes.text: I ran upstairs and checked his room.
scenes.visual: young woman's hand on the doorknob of a child's bedroom in a dark upstairs hallway
scenes.pt: Subi correndo e olhei o quarto dele.

scenes.text: He was fast asleep. The window was locked tight.
scenes.visual: locked bedroom window with moonlight coming through thin curtains
scenes.pt: Ele estava dormindo pesado. A janela estava bem trancada.

scenes.text: So I lay on the couch and pretended to sleep.
scenes.visual: young woman lying on a couch in a dark living room, eyes open, TV off
scenes.pt: Então deitei no sofá e fingi que estava dormindo.

scenes.visual: baby monitor glowing on a coffee table in a dark living room
scenes.pt: A babá eletrônica chiou de novo.

scenes.text: Then a second voice answered. Not from the monitor.
scenes.visual: dark living room seen from behind the couch, a tall shadow standing in the doorway
scenes.pt: Aí uma segunda voz respondeu. Não veio da babá eletrônica.

scenes.text: I kept my eyes shut and counted the footsteps on the carpet.
scenes.visual: close-up of a young woman's closed trembling eyes in the dark
scenes.pt: Fiquei de olhos fechados e contei os passos no tapete.

scenes.text: Four steps. Then nothing. Right beside me.
scenes.visual: a tall shadow falling across a woman lying on a couch in a dark room
scenes.pt: Quatro passos. Depois nada. Bem do meu lado.

scenes.text: Would you have opened your eyes?
scenes.visual: empty couch in a dark living room, blanket on the floor, baby monitor glowing
